structuredContent.governing_intent: Create a single reviewable CANDIDATE Product Intent design document for the Pre-Python gate at docs/architecture/pre-python-gate/product-intent.md, using the supplied authoritative architecture, gate, EOS, Node evidence, and named local baselines without implementing code or approving architecture.
structuredContent.summary: The work packet has a clear documentation-only outcome, bounded writable scope, explicit source authority, explicit exclusions, and observable acceptance criteria. It is ready for autonomous drafting of the candidate product-intent artifact, with unresolved material Founder decisions to be recorded in the document rather than invented or silently resolved.
implementation_unknowns: Where the named local baseline/source documents are located in the repository and which exact sections correspond to reset §§2–13,39–40, current-strategy, canonical-architecture, EOS, Node evidence, and archive references.
The existing documentation conventions, front matter, packet/readiness evidence format, and any local checker commands used for architecture documentation coverage.
How much prior neighboring candidate material exists and how to preserve reconciliation links without implicitly adopting those documents as authority.
The exact wording needed to map each acceptance row to source/invariant evidence while keeping proposed semantics labelled CANDIDATE.
structuredContent.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable through document review: the artifact can be checked for explicit users, problem, value, non-goals, repository-neutral intent, multi-repository scope, distinction between work-unit DONE/feature convergence/product outcome, source-to-invariant mapping, contract semantics with successful and failing examples, scope limitations, unresolved Founder decisions, and compliance with the stated documentation-only boundaries. One independent content review against the supplied rows and source authority is meaningful because the output is a single design artifact with no operational side effects.
material_risks: Accidentally presenting candidate product, architecture, security, storage, or workflow semantics as Founder-approved rather than proposed for later approval.
Over-inventing product intent instead of reusing and mapping the supplied source material and accepted decisions.
Implicitly adopting neighboring documents or draft EOS material beyond the authority granted in the work packet.
Blurring documentation-only scope by changing source, tests, config, services, secrets, runtime behavior, or Python implementation artifacts.
Missing traceability from claims in the design document back to the authorized source sections, which would weaken reviewability.
structuredContent.next_action: Proceed to draft the single candidate product-intent document and any local packet/readiness evidence permitted by the work packet, keeping all claims traceable, candidate-labelled where appropriate, and confined to the authorized documentation paths.
structuredContent.rationale: The controlling condition is readiness rather than clarification, split, or hold: the owner intent is specific, the work is a cohesive single design-document BIU, governing authority and exclusions are extensive, and the acceptance criteria support an independent review verdict. Remaining uncertainties are normal implementation/documentation research about locating and mapping sources, not unresolved owner intent. No unavailable external prerequisite is established by the supplied text, and no materially independent decision centers require splitting.
